recentItems.title: China Speeds up Next-gen Telecom Network Construction
recentItems.description:
China has been accelerating the construction of its next-gen telecommunications network this year with infrastructure upgrades and a focus on innovation.

Last year, the country established 136 pilot programs to test a 10-gigabit optical network, including in Chongqing Municipality at chemical plants, industrial parks, factories, and residential communities.
Beyond the 10-gigabit optical network, China has also upgraded its 5G base stations to 5G-Advanced, or 5G-A, to meet demad from emerging industries, like embodied AI.

China has been accelerating its satellite internet infrastructure by launching several batches of satellites into orbit, and has also direct-to-cell satellite communication.

Going forward the country plans to accelerate the development of an all-domain communication foundation that integrates land, sea, air, and space.

recentItems.title: Robot Ambulances Fix Faulty Robots on Spot in China
recentItems.description:
In Beijing, a new service is helping treat broken or faulty robots on the spot. It's a robot ambulance, like this one, called to a mall to treat a broken robo-dog.

After the ambulance arrived an engineer inspected and repaired the malfunctioning dog in less than an hour.
Besides on-site repairs the ambulances also provide on-site maintenance, detailing, and recycling services for rented robots.

In addition to competing on robot rental services, many robot rental companies are also expanding into value-added services related to event operations.

Data from a Chinese credit information inquiry platform shows that as of April this year, there were some 150,000 robot-rental companies nationwide, a 55 percent increase from the year prior.
